entities.summary: Brandon Aiyuk is an American professional football wide receiver who most recently played for the San Francisco 49ers. He played college football for the Sierra College Wolverines and Arizona State Sun Devils and was selected by the San Francisco 49ers in the first round of the 2020 NFL draft.
